[[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], a prominent engineer during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], maintained his own '''personal museum''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The museum was located over a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] beneath [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Sienar Systems]] main plant. The museum contained a hallway displaying [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of Sienar's previous work, as well as two thousand and twelve exhibits of failed ships and weapons. In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Sienar met with [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]], to discuss Sienar leading a mission to the living planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Raith Sienar's museum appeared in [[Greg Bear]]'s ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', a novel released in [[May]] [[2000]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
